title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the equation i hbar f'' - (f')^2 + p^2 = 0.

title: Power Series Terms
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and write the equations for (f_0')^2 = p^2, i f_0'' = 2 f_0' f_1', and i f_1'' = 2 f_0' f_2' + (f_1')^2.

title: Solution for f_0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly solve for f_0(x) as f_0 = ± ∫ p(x) dx + const.

title: Solution for f_1
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly solve for f_1(x) as f_1 = (i/2) ln p + const.

title: Final WKB Result
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the final wave function as ψ ≈ C/√p exp(± (i/hbar) ∫ p dx).

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Schrödinger equation.

title: Series Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the power series expansion and collect like powers of hbar.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units throughout the derivation.
